response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and leadership in project development, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML, client advisory, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for the role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across diverse technologies and environments
Strong track record of mentoring and conducting technical workshops
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No explicit evidence of UML, IT architecture design, or client advisory experience
Lacks documented experience leading or managing teams in an IT consulting context
